senses.gloss:
(I)--a daughter of Meru and धारणि; married सागर and brought forth a daughter. सवर्णा;
1: वा. ३०. ३५.
she was married to प्राचीनबर्हिस् to whom were born ten sons collec- tively known as Pracetas versed in Dhanur Veda.
2: Br. II. १३, ३७, ३९-40.
(II)--a daughter of भद्राश्व and घृताचि. वा. ७०. ६९.
